authorityBasis: Project-owner direction to continue the governed production-candidate campaign without making the private repository public after GitHub rejected required-reviewer configuration for the production-signing environment under the repository's current plan eligibility.

planConstraintEvidence.interpretation: Required-reviewer environment protection is not configurable for this private repository under the current GitHub plan eligibility.

failClosedConditions: The exception is invalid for any build other than build 5.
The exception is invalid if the dispatch approval reference differs from BAF-REF-003-C4.
The exception is invalid if the workflow actor or triggering actor is not the authorized dispatcher.
The exception is invalid if the repository is not private.
The exception is invalid if the live environment name or required secret-name inventory differs.
The exception is invalid if a required-reviewer rule is configured; the governed policy must then return to reviewer-enforced mode.
Any GitHub plan-eligibility change requires source re-adjudication before a later production-candidate build.
The exception does not authorize distribution, deployment, promotion or unrestricted plant release.
expiresWhen: Build 5 is represented by a verified remote built tag or the governed repository/environment state differs, whichever occurs first.
